candidate_observations.address: Brislington Concourse, Bath Road, Bristol, BS4 5BQ
observed_facts: The leasehold retail parade contains 23 shops and one flat and was Sold Prior without a published price.
Published gross rent is £189,227 with four vacant units and a mix of holding-over, tenancy-at-will and break-sensitive occupations.
Two superior leases from Bristol City Council have approximately 69 and 71 years remaining and carry £10,200 total annual ground rent.
A 2023 study considered 96 flats and eight shops, but the source does not state that planning permission was granted.
candidate_observations.guardrail: Gross rent was not converted into net income; vacant units received no rent, superior rent was separated, and the feasibility study was not represented as planning permission or development value.

candidate_observations.address: 12-14 Butcher Row and 6-7 Ox Row, Salisbury, Wiltshire, SP1 1EP
observed_facts: Costa Limited, company 01270695, is active and pays £63,000 under a ten-year lease from 23 June 2017.
The occupational term ends on 22 June 2027 and no later contracted rent is published.
The first and second floors provide 2,247 square feet of vacant accommodation.
Residential conversion potential is subject to consents; the property was Sold Prior without a published price.
candidate_observations.guardrail: No sale price, post-June-2027 income, upper-floor rent or residential development value was inferred.

observed_facts: The 1,255-square-foot office/live/work maisonette is offered with vacant possession.
The interest is a 999-year virtual freehold from 25 March 1999 at £200 annual rent.
The property includes two bedrooms, a garage and a balcony.
Conversion to full residential use is subject to necessary consents and the auction status is Deferred.
candidate_observations.guardrail: No occupational rent, sale price, residential permission or development value was inferred; the £200 superior rent was retained as a cost rather than income.

candidate_observations.address: Boots, 66-70 Union Street, Torquay, Devon, TQ2 5PS
observed_facts: Boots UK Limited, company 00928555, is active and pays £40,000 under a renewed five-year lease from 16 April 2026.
The nominal term ends in April 2031 but the tenant may determine on 16 April 2029.
The property is freehold and provides approximately 11,887 square feet over retail and ancillary accommodation.
The property remains Available and the guide is not published.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The £40,000 rent was not projected beyond the April 2029 break; no guide price or renewal beyond 2031 was inferred, and general company charges were not treated as property default.

candidate_observations.address: Unit 11 Albion Industrial Estate, Endemere Road, Coventry, CV6 5PY
observed_facts: The freehold vehicle-repair workshop sold for £399,000.
Steer Automotive Group Ltd pays £36,000 under a ten-year lease ending 4 February 2029.
The published lease has no breaks.
The property comprises approximately 2,373 square feet on a 0.18-acre site with about 12 parking spaces.
candidate_observations.guardrail: No rent beyond February 2029 or additional site value was inferred.

candidate_observations.address: 85-95 Great Portland Street and related blocks, London, W1W 7NY
observed_facts: The West End freehold ground-rent investment sold for £805,000 and produces a £16,203 headline total.
The mixed-use estate is arranged over three blocks with commercial and residential reversions in 2077 and 2086.
The schedule includes £12,000 received by the freeholder as 50% of a telecom underlease rent, alongside long-lease rents and a holding-over substation at a shilling.
Some long-lease rents step from £2,000 to £3,000 in 2028 and £4,000 in 2053.
candidate_observations.guardrail: Future stepped rents were not treated as current income; telecom, residential, commercial and nominal substation components were not collapsed into one occupational covenant and no reversion value was calculated.

candidate_observations.address: Unit 29 Skelton Industrial Estate, Skelton, Teesside, TS12 2LQ
observed_facts: The freehold industrial investment sold for £280,000 and the published rent is £28,313.
The lease nominally runs to 25 July 2033 but has a tenant break and rent review on 25 July 2028.
Endeavour Leisure (UK) Ltd, company 08010436, is in administration; the listing also states that a personal guarantor supports the lease.
The property comprises approximately 9,258 square feet on 0.467 acres.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The lease was not treated as secure to 2033, the guarantor was not assumed to cure administration risk, and no 2028 reviewed rent was calculated.

candidate_observations.address: Havelock Place, Priory Quarter, Havelock Road, Hastings, TN34 1BG
observed_facts: The freehold office building sold for £605,000 with vacant possession.
The building provides approximately 24,516 square feet over ground and five upper floors.
The accommodation is capable of subdivision and is described as suitable for owner occupation, multi-letting or alternative asset-management strategies.
Alternative strategies remain subject to necessary consents.
candidate_observations.guardrail: No occupational rent, subdivision completion, alternative-use permission or development value was inferred.
